# Rules and checks

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs:rules` from src/rules/registry.ts and src/swift/heuristics.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every rule below points to a Human Interface Guidelines page and was confirmed on the live page when it was added. At runtime, `hig_checklist`, `review_swiftui` and `check_contrast` fetch that page again and quote the one sentence (or table row) the rule is based on. If Apple has reworded it, or the locator matches more than one sentence, the citation comes back as `verified: false`, with no quote. A citation matched against an expired cached copy, because Apple could not be reached, is also unverified and marked `source: "stale-cache"`.

`npm run smoke` re-checks every rule against the live site. Each rule's locator must match exactly one sentence. Its platforms must be covered by the page's supported platforms and by any platform heading above the sentence. Its numbers must appear in the cited text.

The "What to look for" text is our own paraphrase. It keeps Apple's hedges ("consider", "prefer", "ideally"). Apple's wording appears only in the live quotes. The registry is in [`src/rules/registry.ts`](../src/rules/registry.ts).

## SwiftUI heuristics (`review_swiftui`)

`<platform>` means the per-platform rule variant, for example `controls.size.macos`. iPadOS uses the iOS rules. Before any check runs, the code is masked: comments and string contents are blanked, and `#if os(...)` branches that don't apply to the target platform are removed.

| Check | Rule | What it flags | Known false positives |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hit-target-size` | `controls.size.<platform>` | Button, Link, Toggle, Menu or onTapGesture view whose bounds are readable: a literal .frame on the control, or on the label's single root view plus literal padding. Below the platform minimum is high, below the default is medium; non-literal padding makes it a low-severity advisory. Frames on nested views are not used. | Hit area enlarged by a custom ButtonStyle or a parent view; decorative images are never checked. |
| `fixed-font-size` | `type.dynamic-type` | .system(size:), .custom(_, fixedSize:) or UIFont.systemFont(ofSize:) — sizes that do not follow Dynamic Type. .custom(_, size:) scales with body and is not flagged; @ScaledMetric sizes are skipped. | Deliberately fixed text (e.g. a large clock face) or sizes scaled manually elsewhere. |
| `font-below-minimum` | `type.size.<platform>` | Literal font size below the platform minimum text size. | Tiny decorative glyphs that are not text. |
| `hard-coded-color` | `dark.adaptive-colors` | Color(red:green:blue:), Color(hex:), Color(.sRGB, …), Color(white:), UIColor(red:…), #colorLiteral, and fixed .black/.white foregrounds/backgrounds. | Brand colors intentionally fixed and checked in both appearances; colors only used in previews. |
| `icon-only-button-label` | `a11y.labels` | Advisory (low severity): Button whose label is only an Image, with no Text/Label and no local .accessibilityLabel — a possible missing descriptive label to confirm with VoiceOver. | SF Symbols provide default VoiceOver descriptions; labels set by a custom ButtonStyle or a wrapper view. |
| `tap-gesture-as-button` | `buttons.press-state` | onTapGesture on a non-shape view without .accessibilityAddTraits(.isButton): acts as a button with no press state and no button trait. | Supplementary taps that duplicate a real control; views that implement their own pressed appearance. |
| `ignores-safe-area-content` | `layout.safe-area` | .ignoresSafeArea()/.edgesIgnoringSafeArea on a container or custom view rather than on a background (Color, gradient, Image, shape, Map, or inside .background). | Custom views that are themselves backgrounds; containers whose content handles insets itself. |
| `screen-bounds-layout` | `layout.size-classes` | UIScreen.main.bounds, UIDevice.current.orientation or userInterfaceIdiom used in view code. | Non-layout uses (analytics, one-off sizing of offscreen rendering); idiom checks for behavior rather than layout. |
| `alert-button-count` | `alert.max-buttons`, `actionsheet.max-buttons.watchos` | .alert actions with more than three Buttons shown at once (if/else branches count as alternatives; ForEach/switch skip the check); on watchOS, .confirmationDialog with more than four including Cancel. | Conditions that are never true together across separate if statements. |
| `segmented-count` | `segmented.count` | Picker with .segmented style and more literal .tag() options than the HIG suggests (5 on iPhone, 7 in wide layouts); if/else branches count as alternatives, ForEach/switch skip the check. | iPad-only or Mac layouts reviewed with platform "ios"; pass the right platform. |
| `light-font-weight` | `type.light-weights` | .ultraLight, .thin or .light font weights. | Large display text where light weights stay legible. |
